subject: Authorization request: senior platform SWE (runtime) - Q2 capacity
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-03-03T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Authorization request: 1 Senior Platform SWE (runtime) - Q2 capacity

Hi Kim / Marissa,

Requesting authorization to open one senior platform SWE role focused on runtime/infra optimizations for Q2 hires. Background: the team needs a senior engineer to lead kernel optimizations, KV cache improvements, and batching refinements to meet our Q3 latency and throughput targets for Dedicated. We anticipate the role to materially reduce unit costs by ~8-12% over 6 months (see attached HC cost model).

Details: 
- Role: Senior Platform SWE, Runtime (IC6)
- Justification: gap in senior ownership for kernel/quant paths; ongoing regressions in 99th percentile latency for specific long-tail sequences
- Location: US remote (payband: SNR-P6)
- Budget impact: net-new headcount, cost in 2029Q2 (see hc-cost-breakdown-2029Q1.xlsx)
- Target start: earliest offer in May 2029

Attachments: hc-cost-breakdown-2029Q1.xlsx (cost model), suggested offer template will follow.

Asks: 1) Kim — can you authorize the slot and confirm we can convert an existing contractor tranche or must this be net-new? 2) Marissa — can Recruiting/TA start outreach to the shortlist vendors (Dirk at CloudPartners and Hireflow)?

Thanks — Marcus

Marcus Lin
Director, Platform Infra
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-03-03T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Authorization request: 1 Senior Platform SWE (runtime) - Q2 capacity

Marcus — thanks for the summary. A couple quick clarifying questions before I greenlight: 

1) Is this definitely net-new, or is there a contractor we can convert and keep budget neutral for Q2? If conversion is possible, that changes the approval path.
2) Can you confirm the proposed payband and an expected on-target total comp range to share with Hannah and HR?
3) Do we have a hiring plan (panel, interview loop) scoped or should TA propose one?

If we can convert a contractor, I can approve without escalating to exec budget changes. If it's net-new, I need Marissa to run the budget impact and Hannah to confirm.

Appreciate the attachments — will review and return by EOD.

— Kim

Kimberly Park
VP, People Operations

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Dirk Olson <dirk.olson@cloudpartners.com>
Date: 2029-03-03T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Authorization request: 1 Senior Platform SWE (runtime) - Q2 capacity

On Sun, Mar 3, 2029 at 10:02 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Marcus — thanks for the summary. A couple quick clarifying questions before I greenlight: 
> 1) Is this definitely net-new, or is there a contractor we can convert and keep budget neutral for Q2?

Kim — we've evaluated the contractor roster and the closest match is currently used on edge-serving work and cannot be repurposed without leaving a critical gap. So this will be net-new for Q2.

Payband: SNR-P6 suggested. Expected comp range (total cash + equity uplift): $300k - $360k for US candidates in target markets (mid-SF / remote-adjusted). We calibrated against market comps and internal parity (see hc-cost-breakdown-2029Q1.xlsx).

Hiring plan: TA proposed interview loop with a technical deep-dive (kernel/quant focus), systems design loop, and an exec-level bar check. Soojin is copied to scope the loop and vendor outreach. Dirk from CloudPartners can provide three prescreened candidates in 2 weeks if we confirm engagement.

If Kim can provisionally authorize the slot, Marissa and I will route final budget numbers to Hannah for sign-off.

Thanks — Marcus

Marcus Lin
Director, Platform Infra

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-03-04T08:56:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Authorization request: 1 Senior Platform SWE (runtime) - Q2 capacity

Kim / Marcus — I've reviewed the attached cost sheet and run a quick scenario: net-new hire will add an incremental OTE burden of ~1.15 FTE-equivalent fully loaded for 2029 (pro-rated). I've uploaded the formal HC request to the central approval form (link below) and flagged it as high-priority for Q2.

GDrive: https://drive.redwood.ai/forms/hc-2029Q1 (request form with line-item budget)

Operational asks for TA: 
- Soojin, please confirm interview loop and panel availability.
- Marcus, please confirm fallback routing if candidate expectations exceed SNR-P6.
- Kim, if you can provisionally authorize the slot (headcount authorization only), I'll schedule finance validation and route to Hannah for final sign-off by EOD Tuesday.

Also looping in Dirk (CloudPartners) in case we want to expedite vendor outreach; Dirk — can you confirm typical lead time for senior runtime candidates and expected markup?

Attachments: senior-platform-swe-offer-packet.pdf (draft offer language).

— Marissa

Marissa Cole
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Dirk Olson <dirk.olson@cloudpartners.com>, talentops@hireflow.io
Date: 2029-03-05T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Authorization request: 1 Senior Platform SWE (runtime) - Q2 capacity

Thanks all — I approve the headcount authorization for one net-new Senior Platform SWE (Runtime). Conditions: 
1) Offer must stay within SNR-P6 band; any exceptions (above $360k TCE) require explicit CFO confirmation.
2) Recruiting to prioritize candidates with proven kernel/quantization experience to shorten ramp.
3) Marissa to confirm finance sign-off and update the HC tracker; Kim — please mark the slot as "approved - pending offer details".

Soojin/TA: proceed with vendor engagement; Dirk — please share 3 CVs in 10 business days and include expected cost/markup in your reply.

Once Marissa confirms finance, HR can extend an offer. If there are any comp exceptions or counteroffer risks, escalate to me directly.

Hannah Schmitt
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference
